subject: ipc
source: International Primary Curriculum (IPC), Milepost 2 thematic units — Fieldwork Education

weeks.topic: Brainwave: how memory works and ways to revise
objectives: Explain short-term and long-term memory
Try strategies that help us remember

weeks.topic: Brainwave: thinking skills, collaboration and international mindedness
objectives: Practise working well in a team
Explore what it means to be internationally minded

weeks.topic: Temples, Tombs and Treasures: what makes a civilisation?
objectives: Identify features of early civilisations
Place Egypt, Sumer, the Indus Valley and Shang China on a timeline

weeks.topic: Temples, Tombs and Treasures: the Nile and farming in Ancient Egypt
objectives: Explain why the Nile was vital to Egyptians
Describe the farming seasons of flood, growth and harvest

weeks.topic: Temples, Tombs and Treasures: pyramids, pharaohs and the afterlife
objectives: Explain Egyptian beliefs about the afterlife
Describe how and why pyramids were built

weeks.topic: Temples, Tombs and Treasures: hieroglyphs and early writing
objectives: Compare hieroglyphs with cuneiform
Write a message using hieroglyphs

weeks.topic: Temples, Tombs and Treasures: archaeology and Tutankhamun's tomb
objectives: Find out how Howard Carter discovered Tutankhamun's tomb
Explain how archaeologists use evidence

weeks.topic: Temples, Tombs and Treasures: Egyptian art and a class museum
objectives: Explore Egyptian art, jewellery and symbols
Create artefacts for a class museum

weeks.topic: How Humans Work: the skeleton and muscles
objectives: Explain the functions of the skeleton
Describe how muscles work in pairs to move bones

weeks.topic: How Humans Work: the digestive system and teeth
objectives: Describe the basic parts of the digestive system
Identify types of teeth and their jobs

weeks.topic: How Humans Work: the heart and blood circulation
objectives: Describe how the heart pumps blood around the body
Measure pulse before and after exercise

weeks.topic: How Humans Work: lungs and breathing
objectives: Explain how we breathe in and out
Describe why the body needs oxygen

weeks.topic: How Humans Work: healthy diet and exercise
objectives: Identify the main food groups
Explain why exercise and sleep keep us healthy

weeks.topic: How Humans Work: the senses and the nervous system
objectives: Describe how the senses send messages to the brain
Investigate reaction times

weeks.topic: Review: Temples, Tombs and Treasures and How Humans Work
objectives: Revise Ancient Egypt and early civilisations
Revise the main systems of the human body

weeks.topic: Explorers and Adventurers: why do people explore?
objectives: Discuss reasons for exploration such as trade, curiosity and fame
Identify qualities of an explorer

weeks.topic: Explorers and Adventurers: Zheng He and Columbus — voyages across oceans
objectives: Compare the voyages of Zheng He and Christopher Columbus
Trace their routes on a map

weeks.topic: Explorers and Adventurers: Cabral and the Portuguese arrival in Brazil
objectives: Describe Cabral's voyage of 1500
Discuss the impact on indigenous peoples

weeks.topic: Explorers and Adventurers: navigation with compasses and maps
objectives: Use a compass and eight compass points
Locate places using latitude and longitude lines

weeks.topic: Explorers and Adventurers: polar explorers and keeping warm
objectives: Find out about Shackleton and Amundsen
Investigate which materials are the best insulators

weeks.topic: Explorers and Adventurers: exploring space and the deep ocean
objectives: Compare modern exploration of space and the ocean
Explain how technology helps explorers

weeks.topic: They Made a Difference: what makes a person significant?
objectives: Agree criteria for significance
Rank significant people using the criteria

weeks.topic: They Made a Difference: inventors and scientists who changed the world
objectives: Research inventors such as Edison and Marie Curie
Explain how their work changed lives

weeks.topic: They Made a Difference: campaigners for equality and rights
objectives: Find out about Rosa Parks, Nelson Mandela and Malala Yousafzai
Discuss how they fought for fairness

weeks.topic: They Made a Difference: Brazilian changemakers
objectives: Research Oswaldo Cruz, Chico Mendes and Zilda Arns
Explain their impact on Brazil

weeks.topic: They Made a Difference: making a difference in our community
objectives: Plan a small action to help the school or local community
Reflect on its impact

weeks.topic: Mid-year assessment: Explorers and They Made a Difference
objectives: Explain why explorers travelled and what they found
Describe how significant people changed the world

weeks.topic: Chocolate: the cacao tree and where it grows
objectives: Locate cacao-growing countries near the Equator
Describe the conditions cacao trees need

weeks.topic: Chocolate: the Maya and Aztecs and the story of chocolate
objectives: Find out how the Maya and Aztecs used cacao
Explain how chocolate spread to Europe

weeks.topic: Chocolate: fair trade from farmer to consumer
objectives: Trace the journey of chocolate from farm to shop
Explain how fair trade helps farmers

weeks.topic: Chocolate: melting and solidifying
objectives: Investigate the temperature at which chocolate melts
Describe changes of state between solid and liquid

weeks.topic: Different Places, Similar Lives: our city and a contrasting locality
objectives: Compare São Paulo with a village in another continent
Identify similarities and differences

weeks.topic: Different Places, Similar Lives: climate, weather and daily life
objectives: Describe how climate affects daily life
Compare weather data from two places

weeks.topic: Different Places, Similar Lives: schools, jobs and families around the world
objectives: Compare schools, jobs and family life in different countries
Discuss what all children share

weeks.topic: Different Places, Similar Lives: how trade and communication connect us
objectives: Explain how trade and technology connect places
Find products we use from other countries

weeks.topic: End-of-year assessment: Year 4 IPC units
objectives: Show learning from the year's units
Explain links between history, geography and science topics

weeks.topic: Review and reflection on Milepost 2 learning
objectives: Reflect on progress in the IPC Personal Goals
Prepare for Milepost 3 learning
